weapon_class.description: Restrict to one class, e.g. 'Katana', 'Colossal Sword', 'Greatshield'. Without it the ranking is across all 570 weapons, shields and catalysts included.

affinity.description: 'Standard' (default) prices every weapon as found. 'best' prices all thirteen infusions of each infusable weapon and keeps its winner, which is a different question and a higher list. A named affinity prices every infusable weapon with it.

two_hand.description: True if the build two-hands, which lowers the strength each weapon needs.

limit.description: How many rows to return, best first. Default 15.

include_unusable.description: Keep the weapons whose requirements the build does not meet, each with its shortfall. Default false — a weapon that cannot be held is not a weak option, it is not an option.

spell.description: Rank catalysts by what this spell hits for out of each, instead of ranking weapons by attack rating. Resolve the name with spell-power first.

starting_class.description: Which class the character started as; one of the ten.
